name: Qin Lin
title: Assistant Professor; Assured and Intelligent Robotics Lab director
department: Department of Engineering Technology, Cullen College of Engineering
fitReason: Strong methods-to-hardware fit in combining neural disturbance models with stabilizing feedback and uncertainty-aware control on real aerial and manipulation systems.

physicalEvidence.summary: Neural-ESO (July 7, 2026; RA-L acceptance June 2026) runs a neural disturbance predictor alongside a corrective observer on a ModalAI Seeker with VOXL/PX4. OptiTrack supplies pose; an Intel i9 ground station sends 50 Hz offboard commands. Actual landing and near-ground maneuvers test normal and shifted conditions. A separate July 2026 study runs online conformal uncertainty bounds and control-barrier safety on a 7-DoF Franka Research 3 at 1 kHz, including a sloshing-water payload. Its residual neural controller is a comparison baseline, not the proposed conformal controller. Both papers have current UH-affiliated advisees and are linked as current AIR projects.

shortVisit.summary: Official faculty page confirms appointment and public email. Current university-hosted AIR site and publications identify recent advisees and ongoing 2026 work. No explicit current external graduate short-visit invitation was found. The older personal site explicitly directs readers to the new UH lab.
